exec: pm.test('GDP-100 - returns the 3 orders buyer A placed', () => pm.expect(orders.length).to.eql(3));
pm.test('GDP-100 - every order belongs to buyer A', () => orders.forEach(o => pm.expect(String(o.buyer)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('buyerAId'))));
pm.test('GDP-100 - sorted newest first', () => { for (let i = 1; i < orders.length; i++) pm.expect(new Date(orders[i-1].createdAt) >= new Date(orders[i].createdAt)).to.be.true; });
pm.test('GDP-100 AC2 - each order has status, address, date and total', () => orders.forEach(o => pm.expect(o).to.include.keys('status','deliveryAddress','createdAt','total')));
pm.test('GDP-103 - the cancelled order shows status cancelled in history', () => pm.expect(orders.map(o => o.status)).to.include('cancelled'));
